note: Graph answers are kept only for 'pick' answers with path score >= 52 on the general pack. Calibrated offline on Mintaka DEV (2,000 questions; tools/glm_parity/pocket_scores_dev.json from tools/glm_parity/pocket_scores.mjs, the page's own engine). Precision of kept answers: 20/32 = 62.5% (in-sample on dev; split halves 9/18 and 11/14, so it is noisy). The ~70% target is NOT reached by any score cut: the best all-types cut is about 50-56%, and count / largest / yes-no answers stay near their base rate at any score. Everything below the cut goes to the on-device LM when it is on, or is shown with a low-confidence note. The movies pack uses a different scorer scale, so there any committed answer is kept. No sealed data was used.
